executive_decision.rationale: The S844-S848 chain demonstrated that the controlled pilot is OPERATIONALLY VIABLE: defects were found and fixed, calibration works at scale, research is high-quality, and governance holds. However, the chain also confirmed that CONTENT AUTHORING is the bottleneck — 32 Analyze/Evaluate upgrades remain deferred (~13.8 hours). Full Part 2 expansion (≥80) requires actual content creation, not just planning and calibration. The program is on the right trajectory (54→60→65) but not yet at escape velocity.
executive_decision.not_hold: Program is making measurable progress on all dimensions. Governance is solid. Pipeline is validated. Next phase is execution, not planning.
executive_decision.not_expand: Full expansion requires ≥80 readiness score (currently 65). The critical path is Analyze/Evaluate content authoring (~32 items, ~13.8 hours). Expansion should be authorized in stages as content creation milestones are met.
